name: io.github.jpka/shopify-operations-mcp
title: shopify-operations-mcp
description: Safe-write Shopify operations MCP server: plan-before-execute writes with out-of-band approval and audit.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: The myshopify.com store domain, e.g. my-store.myshopify.com. Overrides shopify.storeDomain from the config file.

environmentVariables.name: SHOPIFY_ADMIN_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Shopify Admin API access token. Required and only ever read from the environment — never from the config file.
